raw_entities.name: Information Security Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's formal information security policy governing the protection of systems, data, and operational resilience. Effective from 2026-01-15, owned by the Chief Information Security Officer and applicable to all staff, technology, risk, and board audiences. The policy is mandated by FCA COBS Part 5 and PRA Operational Resilience requirements.

raw_entities.description: Prudential Regulation Authority regulatory framework requiring operational resilience standards, including information security and business continuity measures applicable to FirstUK Bank.
